original_test_intent: Inject one owner-approved PCIe Correctable Link CRC TX fault at the verified AMD GPU path and prove correctable handling through the amdgpuras result, Firmware-First APEI/AER BadTLP records, intact PCIe enumeration and matching BMC SEL/CPER evidence.
original_method: A qualified operator records and sets the four BIOS controls, then capture immutable GPU/card/BDF/socket/downstream-port mapping and full baseline logs/topology. After FAE confirmation and explicit authorization, execute exactly one mapped block-5/sub-block-1/type-2 injection. Correlate timestamped tool, dmesg/journal/APEI/CPER, AER downstream port, lspci and protected BMC Dump/SEL evidence; halt on any severity escalation or device/topology loss.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE confirms the live device/port/injection map and dedicated-SUT authorization; an operator applies BIOS controls and maintains recovery console; the owner reviews all correlated evidence and decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Dedicated SUT, recovery console and maintenance authorization
BIOS/firmware/AER/DPC/Hotplug recipe and before/after setting evidence
Exact GPU device/card/BDF/socket and downstream root/switch-port topology
Expected corrected APEI/AER/BadTLP fields and CPER/SEL correlation
Protected authenticated TLS BMC Redfish/SEL access and recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Run only on the dedicated approved SUT with console and recovery ready
Do not clear baseline dmesg, journal, CPER, SEL or Dump entries
Verify the live target and BIOS controls immediately before injection
Use one explicit approval for one injection; never substitute another device or port
Use protected Redfish authentication and retain complete outputs
Stop on uncorrected/fatal severity, GPU loss, hang, topology change or unexpected BDF/port
Do not repeat injection or reboot automatically
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only BIOS, GPU/BDF/topology and full baseline log evidence
Validate tool capability and prepare the exact mapped injection command
Execute the one injection only after explicit approval
Collect and correlate full host AER/APEI/CPER, lspci and protected BMC evidence
Perform no BIOS write, target choice, severity disposition, retry/reboot decision or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve BIOS setup, exact live target and block/sub-block/type semantics
Approve dedicated-SUT fault injection and recovery/abort procedure
Review corrected severity, BadTLP port, PCIe integrity and BMC match; issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

review_improvement: Restores the complete one-shot RAS path, isolates the thermal duplicate, replaces log clearing/plaintext BMC access with immutable secure correlation, and makes escalation/no-retry behavior explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: The injection device index is assigned by the live amdgpuras enumeration and example BDFs cannot identify the same physical GPU on another boot or platform. Firmware-First handling also means the expected corrected record may name upstream and downstream bridge components rather than only the endpoint. Acceptance therefore requires a pre-bound topology and timestamp correlation across tool, APEI/AER, PCIe enumeration and BMC logs; clearing baselines or repeating the injection would destroy causality and increase risk.
